_comment: Residual-probe prompt set: each character prompt with its name-stripped twin (*_tags = drop the character name; *_tags_nc = drop name + copyright). The probe measures the *name contribution* Δ = pool(full) − pool(tags) on the teacher (EN) and the student (ja_ext) and reports cos(Δ_S, Δ_T), the norm ratio, and the margin against the other characters' teacher residuals. Keys mirror the grid ids so grid_labels.json applies. Consumed by bench/cjk_adapter/residual_probe.py. Tag-style prompts join with ", " (the primary student joiner since 2026-08-30); prose prompts keep 、 as punctuation.
